title: A chitosan-modified buckwheat hull biochar dynamic adsorption column as a sustainable and efficient technology for lead-acid battery wastewater treatment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, 12,1209-1221
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW01081K, Paper
Jiayu Zhao, Qian Luo, Wenlong Zhao, Cong Li, Junyang Xiao, Junfeng Li, Xuemei Zhu
A dynamic system using chitosan-modified buckwheat biochar (KQB) efficiently removes  Pb(II) via surface complexation, offering superior performance over conventional coagulation methods.
